validations: AC-02: validate protected requirement — Malformed Project identity, run identity, missing/invalid `src:` lineage prefix, non-hex lineage data, or wrong lineage length cannot produce a publication branch.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — `VerifiedLineageDelivery` publishes an accepted lineage on the shared canonical lineage-scoped branch and preserves all existing repository/commit/PR/Preview verification.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — `GreenfieldVerifiedLineageDelivery` uses the identical helper and format after its existing P2-V0.23.42 delivery-base classification. No greenfield-specific branch naming remains.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — Two valid accepted lineages for the same Project/run deterministically derive distinct branch names while retaining identical Project/run prefixes.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Publishing the replacement lineage performs no mutation/delete/force update against the earlier lineage's existing branch, PR or Preview.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — If the exact accepted lineage already has a durable delivery record, delivery returns that record before branch creation and preserves the stored historical branch identity. Exact replay creates no new `SOURCE_DELIVERY` attempt and no provider call.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — New same-run delivery records use monotonically increasing positive `SOURCE_DELIVERY` attempt numbers and satisfy existing database uniqueness without changing Engineering Run lifecycle revision/state.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Same-lineage concurrent insert resolves as exact replay when payloads match. Different-lineage attempt-number contention may retry only the database insert once after recomputing the next stage attempt number; no provider action repeats. Any unresolved or payload conflict fails closed.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — If the canonical lineage-scoped branch exists unexpectedly without exact durable delivery-record authority, provider conflict remains a hard failure. No automatic reuse or alternate branch is attempted.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Record keys, accepted lineage/content digests, exact Git commit/PR/Preview read-back and replay semantics remain lineage-bound and unchanged except that newly persisted results record the canonical lineage-scoped branch and distinct stage attempt number.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — A pre-P2-V0.23.43 durable record containing a run-scoped branch name still decodes and replays unchanged. The release performs no historical record migration or branch rename.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — Diff/tests prove no provider/model/credential/network/command/execution-profile/provider-retry/source-lineage/force-ref/default-branch/merge/production/automatic-REVIEW authority expansion.

AC-15: validate protected requirement — The exact amended spec passes validation plus authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler and strict compiled-plan validation before semantic implementation. Focused tests, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

AC-16: validate protected requirement — The exact merged API source reaches production READY with normal preflights, `/health` and `/ready` HTTP 200 and reviewed exact-deployment runtime scans. Frozen W9-S1 run `a64d56b7-ad42-42ad-9562-891783363f4a` at REVIEW revision 12 retries publication of replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809`. The retry must: - not recur `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`; - not recur `BRANCH_CONFLICT` against prior branch `parallax/0e20392b-a64d56b7`; - create/read a new canonical lineage-scoped feature branch for the replacement lineage; - create/read the exact replacement-lineage commit and a new GitHub PR; - create/read a READY Vercel Preview or existing bounded READY-equivalent result under normal delivery semantics; - persist a distinct exact durable `SOURCE_DELIVERY` record for the replacement lineage without conflicting with the earlier lineage's record; - preserve the original branch and QA PR #1 unchanged; - leave the Engineering Run at human REVIEW revision 12 with `last_failure_code=null`. Any genuinely later independent blocker is recorded separately rather than weakening this boundary.

critique: The same-run source-publication identity defect exposed after P2-V0.23.42 successfully admitted an ordinary commit-bearing empty repository. Distinct accepted source lineages in the same Engineering Run must receive distinct deterministic feature branches and distinct durable `SOURCE_DELIVERY` ledger records so bounded REVIEW rework can publish a replacement candidate without rewriting, deleting, reusing, or conflicting with the publication identity of an earlier reviewed lineage. The change must be shared by ordinary and greenfield accepted-source delivery, preserve exact durable delivery replay for every already-published lineage, and leave every prior branch, pull request, Preview, default branch, merge boundary, and human REVIEW decision untouched.
